newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton output reaches 7.833 mln bales.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton output reaches 7.833 mln bales.

text.p: The state-run Cotton Export Corporation of Pakistan said on Saturday the country's cotton output from the 1996/97 (July-June) crop had reached a provisional 7.833 million 375-lb bales by January 16, down from 8.377 million bales in the same period last year.
It said mills had bought 5.876 million bales, up from 5.846 million in the year-ago period, while exporters had picked up only 2,700 bales against 807,400 bales last year.
A total 1.954 million unsold bales are stocked at ginning factories, compared with 1.724 million bales in the year-ago period, the Corporation said.

Officials estimate the total 1996/97 crop, damaged by pest in the main growing Punjab province, will be close to nine million bales, less than earlier predictions of 10 million bales and last year's production of 9.96 million bales.
